queries.name: postfailure_target_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.COA_ExpedienteReferencias') AND c.name IN ('VentaID','DocumentoFiscalEmitidoID') ORDER BY c.name

queries.name: postfailure_new_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS foreign_key_name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.name IN ('FK_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_Venta','FK_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_DocumentoFiscalEmitido','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Empresa','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Unidad','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Cliente','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Venta','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Estatus','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Moneda','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_CreadoPor','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_ModificadoPor') ORDER BY fk.name

queries.name: postfailure_original_check

queries.name: postfailure_compras_fk_preserved
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,pc.name AS parent_column,rt.name AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fkc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.COA_ExpedienteReferencias') AND pc.name='DocumentoFiscalID'

queries.name: postfailure_coa_reference_rows
